## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated (bugs get a regression test)
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`) if a published package changed
- [ ] API reports refreshed (`pnpm api`) if a public API changed
- [ ] Collected fields, metrics or options changed? `collected-fields.ts` / `metrics.ts` and docs updated
- [ ] No tokens, raw REST paths, headers, message content or raw user IDs are stored or logged
